name: Acceptance test 8 - explicit Deny completely blocks an allowed action
note: IAM-702 deny leak: an Allow of ec2:TerminateInstances on Resource:* is overlapped by an exact same-policy Deny. The grant is fully suppressed by AWS explicit-Deny precedence. A suppressed grant must NOT emit any positive capability edge (previously it leaked into both can-write AND can-destroy edges) and must not count in risk totals - 'denies are not grants' (cross-test invariant 5). Only the informational `denies` edge remains. The authoritative findings table is empty.
